One immutable-accounting VaultV2 has one current lending adapter and one residual USDe market. EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero. Raw deployed code is byte-identical to the October 2 pin; the existing functional compiler-correspondence evidence therefore remains applicable. At Base block 52635700 (2026-10-15T10:39:07.000Z), receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were irreversibly abdicated. sendAssetsGate was zero; its setter remains mutable with a 604800-second selector delay. Verified VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem check the first three gates; deposit/mint checks sendAssetsGate. Deposit-dependent in-kind exits can still be constrained. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle, not a direct share blacklist. addAdapter, removeAdapter, increaseAbsoluteCap, increaseRelativeCap and setSendAssetsGate each have 604800-second delays; setIsAllocator and all four fee/fee-recipient selectors have zero delays. setAdapterRegistry is abdicated. The six direct allocator addresses remain those in controls[]; no sentinel-grant events were found from creation through the pinned block. Curator Safe is now 3-of-9, Supervisor owner remains 5-of-10 and allocator Safe remains 1-of-6. The two previously opaque allocator contracts are now identified as a curator-administered UUPS VaultV2Allocator and immutable BluePublicAllocator; the operator census and public configuration are recorded on their exact controls. FirefighterV2 0xe894e6f6d371dba091b06c3723ac7276ff781698 is an indirect allocator operator with pinned implementation 0xcd6f544d7963fc7b28c92f4eb680d86cfaa3ac79, curator Safe as admin, allocator pointer 0x1be9b8c406120b2c2b8990d0522cd226a3d60e36, and seven active operators (the allocator Safe, 1feed/2feed/3feed/4feed/5feed bot addresses listed in the allocator census, and the direct feed46 account). Its save methods deallocate to idle and its admin can upgrade the helper. Several bot accounts and direct allocators bbf1ad/fc580f use EIP-7702 BatchExecutor delegation rather than empty code. These helper permissions remain allocation-only at the immutable root; no arbitrary USDC mint authority or whole-book borrowing position is inferred. Historical independently reproduced functional source correspondence is retained: Sourcify runtimeMatch=match, matchId 30034094, solc 0.8.28+commit.7893614a, viaIR, optimizer 100000; only declared immutable offsets (asset AST37, decimals AST39, virtualShares AST41) and 11-byte CBOR compiler tag at byte 21796 were masked, and normalized runtime SHA-256 was cf17ab0161388ea9277000e692e929216da2618e441c54bcd677def1000dd12e. Current root bytes equal the old pinned root bytes; that historic proof is not a new compilation or a financial audit. Complete transitive alternate-call execution, fallback-handler noninterference, private human/key-custody safeguards, independently signed vault financial assurance and statutory insolvency priority remain unestablished; none is inferred from the refreshed role/address census.
